fixes: Elevate 'nothing at risk' to a colored status banner

overall.verdict: The xln wallet has a coherent, well-thought-out visual language (green=yours, violet=promised) and genuinely strong trust/dispute/receipt screens that would satisfy security-conscious and treasury users. It falls short for first-timers and casual mobile users who face jargon (frames, lanes, capacity, atomic settlement) without enough inline explanation at the point of confusion.
priority_fixes: Add contextual one-line tooltips wherever jargon (frame, capacity, lane, atomic, promised) first appears instead of a single upfront explainer card
Elevate critical trust/status lines (atomic settlement, nothing at risk, uncovered debt 'Cover it') with color/weight instead of same-style body text
Reconcile duplicate/inconsistent counts and numbers across screens (movement counts, frame numbers) to preserve auditor trust
Simplify disabled/zero-state cards (zero-balance Move cards, disabled Lend CTA) with dimming and inline helper text
Surface Sovereignty/dispute-readiness closer to Home for security-focused users instead of 4 taps deep in Manage
